title: Session cookies are Secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite=Lax on every issue and refresh
asA: operator whose browser holds the credential
iWant: the session cookie kept away from client-side script and away from cross-site request paths
soThat: an XSS injection cannot exfiltrate my session and a cross-site request cannot ride it

acceptanceCriteria.description: Every Set-Cookie header that issues or refreshes the session cookie carries the Secure attribute.
acceptanceCriteria.given: any response that issues or refreshes the session cookie

acceptanceCriteria.description: Every Set-Cookie header that issues or refreshes the session cookie carries the HttpOnly attribute.
acceptanceCriteria.given: any response that issues or refreshes the session cookie

acceptanceCriteria.description: Every Set-Cookie header that issues or refreshes the session cookie carries SameSite=Lax.
acceptanceCriteria.given: any response that issues or refreshes the session cookie
acceptanceCriteria.then: the SameSite attribute is present with value Lax

acceptanceCriteria.description: The session cookie value is not readable by client-side script under the runtime browser policy the app targets.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a browser page authenticated to the deployed app
acceptanceCriteria.when: document.cookie is queried by page script
acceptanceCriteria.then: the returned string contains no substring matching the issued session handle
